name: Tra Khuc river
kicker: The river the city is built on
summary: The south bank is the base when the river and the weekend night street are the reason you stopped. Phố đêm Sông Trà runs Tôn Đức Thắng from 17:00 to 22:00 on Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. Other nights the older night market has been stopped since 2021. The bank has no ticket. Check on arrival for a stall price. The long span in the photograph is not named cầu Thạch Bích.
timeNeeded: A day on the bank, and the evening when the street is on
getThere: The south bank, if you sleep in the center. Minutes from the station are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Fishing boats on the Trà Khúc, and a long span across the channel

notice.title: The street is not every night
notice.body: Phố đêm Sông Trà runs Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays, 17:00–22:00. Other nights the older night market has been stopped since 2021. A Monday arrival does not get that street.

body: You are on the river the city is built on. Fishing boats sit on the water, and a long span crosses the channel. Walk the bank. The bureau calls the mountain-and-river pair Thiên Ấn Niêm Hà and names water wheels that used to turn for the cane fields. The span in this photograph is not named cầu Thạch Bích.

The evening, when it is on, is Phố đêm Sông Trà, about 300 metres of Tôn Đức Thắng. The provincial page runs that street from Công viên Thạch Bích to cầu Thạch Bích. A January 2026 report puts the stalls on the east side of the bridge. It is open 17:00–22:00 on Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. It opened the evening of 6 February 2026. An earlier line had said around 7 February. Both dates stay. A 2026 layout counts 72 stalls: 6 OCOP, 16 souvenirs, 40 food and non-alcohol drinks, and 10 alcohol stalls. The provincial page does not print that split.

On other nights the older night market has been stopped since 2021. No entry fee was printed. In May and June the newspaper’s peak for don is the end of Trường Sa, where the river meets the sea. A commercial page says the bowl is a morning or an evening habit. Both stay. The span in the second photograph is cầu Cổ Lũy. The Don An Phú ground sits to its south, at thôn Phú Thọ. It is not cầu Thạch Bích. Kon Tum and Măng Đen are their own trips.

figures.caption: Cầu Cổ Lũy from above. The Don An Phú ground is to the south. This span is not cầu Thạch Bích.

gettingThere: This is the base if you sleep on the south bank, around Nghĩa Lộ and Thạch Bích. Ga Quảng Ngãi is at 01 Nguyễn Chánh. The minutes from the station to the bank were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the south bank
legs.body: On foot, if you sleep around Nghĩa Lộ and Thạch Bích. A timed walk was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Ga Quảng Ngãi
legs.body: The station is at 01 Nguyễn Chánh. The minutes to Tôn Đức Thắng were not printed. Check on arrival.

closed: The street runs Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. Other nights, the older night market has been stopped since 2021.
